transport.title: Transport
transport.description: How the agent reaches the pod: UDP or TCP over Ethernet, or a TTL serial port.

host.title: Pod IP address
host.description: The pod's IP on the companion network (UDP/TCP transports).

camera_id.title: Camera id
camera_id.description: The camera id stamped on the pod's republished tracker detections.
